name: NHTSA APIs (vPIC, Recalls, Safety Ratings, Complaints)

limits.notes: No key, no published quota. Note this entry spans two host families: vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov (VIN decode) and api.nhtsa.gov (recalls/ratings/complaints). Connector must route per function.

llmDocs.summary: Vehicle data: VIN decoding (vPIC), safety recalls, NCAP crash-test ratings, and consumer complaints. No key. Two API hosts under one logical source.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Append ?format=json. VIN decode lives at vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov; recalls/ratings/complaints live at api.nhtsa.gov with make/model/modelYear query params. Safety ratings is a drill-down: year -> make -> model -> variant -> VehicleId.
gotchas: Two different base hosts; do not assume one host serves all functions.
Safety Ratings requires walking the hierarchy to obtain a VehicleId before fetching the actual ratings.
format=json is needed on vPIC or you get XML.
